During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''fleet battle''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]], leaving dozens of valuable [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulks behind that were stripped of parts and valuables by scavengers.
